## Description

Employs Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) constrained by the Black-Scholes partial differential equation (PDE) to compute real-time options pricing and surface extrapolation.

## Where it may fit

Illiquid options chains, exotic derivatives pricing, high-dimensional multi-asset basket options.

## Vehicles

Derivatives market makers, exotic options trading desks, quantitative research groups.

## Required data

Option order book quotes, spot price, strike price, maturity time, risk-free interest rates.

## Caveats

Loss function optimization requires balance between residual PDE constraint enforcement and empirical data fitting.
